title: Doctrine of the Azure Paired Lance
summary: A doctrine for two riders who strike as mirrored points, ending in one joined impalement.

title: Hawk and Basin: A Lance Elite Canon
summary: An elite canon of the high stoop onto the basin floor and the rim that nets a fleeing foe.

title: Twin Tracks of the Charging Lance
summary: Teaches the dual-track charge that splits along two lines and joins them in a single impact.

title: The Azure Field Lance Compendium
summary: A compendium for Xiantian lancers who cloak the whole lance in a sky-blue qi field.

title: River-Run Lance Mastery
summary: Teaches the lance as a river in flood, from patient pacing to a surge that carries a whole line off.

title: Lance Teachings for the Highest Mortal Riders
summary: Teaches Monarch riders the lance at the ceiling of the mortal road, with one Elite thrust held in reserve.

title: Wind-Sworn Lance Elite Canon
summary: An elite canon for wind-sworn riders who bind the lance to a vow and fulfil it in one thrust.

title: Oath Lance of the Open Plateau
summary: Teaches riders to keep an oath across open plateau with dust, distance and an iron-hard thrust.

title: Bearings of the Great Charge
summary: Teaches the taking and holding of a bearing through the largest charges, ending in a lance fall.

title: Lance Beyond the Last Plateau
summary: Teaches riders to carry the charge off the plateau's edge and beyond, with a lance that outruns its own wake.

title: The Long Oath of the Wind Lance
summary: A long text on keeping a wind oath through a campaign, from breath and pace to the last thrust.

title: Late Mortal Oath Lance of the Wind
